scope: Local saved HTML prose/caption audit; no browser/JavaScript execution, model/API calls, numerical recomputation, experiment code, figure generation, upload, or qualitative sample selection.
method: Static HTML parsed including inert <template> contents. Script/style excluded. Valid JSON HTML string literals checked without evaluation; none found. Exact normalized paragraph hashing supplies deduplication coverage. Cached text and all file hashes verified.
limitations: Published artifacts were not fetched; this is the requested local fallback.
Dynamic chart pixels, tooltip values, JavaScript-generated numerical tables, source-code semantics and raw generation arrays were not inspected.
Compressed payloads were not exhaustively decoded; reproduction001 payload top-level structure was inspected and contained measurements/explorer arrays, while report bodies were in inert templates.
Template placeholders were read for coverage but filled assembled reports and underlying analysis files remain the authority for numbers.
